blocks.text: LINGAYEN, Pangasinan — It’s a special non-working day on Friday, Nov. 13, in Pangasinan as the province commemorates the 130th birth anniversary of former House Speaker Eugenio Perez. Pangasinan Governor Ramon Guico III issued Executive Order 0131-2026 on Nov. 9, enjoining Pangasinenses to observe the occasion and participate in activities honoring Perez’s life and contributions
